Name: Karkat Portrait
Author: Acidikrane
Description:
[center]This is a simple Portrait replacement for Sam since I wasn't a huge fan of his design.
o---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------o
Instead, give a warm welcome to arguably the best troll in Homestuck, Karkat!
This mods all of Sam's portraits, and is the second piece of the Karkat mod set I'm working on.

If you like this mod, make sure to swing over to the matching [url=http://http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/423/?][/url][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/422/?][/url][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/423/?]Sprite page[/url] for the full Karkat experience. 
(I'm still trying to figure out how to modify the dialogue and his name without the game crashing; If anyone could offer insight on this I'd be happy to give it a try!)[/center]
To Install Mod:
[list]
[*](OPTIONAL) Back-up the old Sam.xnb
[/list][list]
[*][size=2]Unzip the 'Karkat_Portrait.zip' file[/size]
[*][size=2]Navigate to "C:\Steam\SteamApps\common\Stardew Valley\Content\Portraits"[/size]
[*][size=2]Replace Sam.xnb with the one you just downloaded.[/size]
[*][size=2]Launch and Enjoy![/size]
[/list]
